description: Source code for the HostMappingRules class, which manages URL host rewriting rules including mapping and exclusion rules, used for URL host remapping in network operations.

classes.name: HostMappingRules
classes.description: Manages URL host rewriting rules, including mapping and exclusion rules, for network URL processing.

classes.name: HostMappingRules::MapRule
classes.description: Represents a rule for mapping a hostname pattern to a replacement hostname and port.

classes.name: HostMappingRules::ExclusionRule
classes.description: Represents a hostname pattern exclusion rule.

methods.name: RewriteHost
methods.description: Attempts to rewrite the host and port of a given HostPortPair based on the mapping and exclusion rules.

methods.name: RewriteUrl
methods.description: Rewrites the URL's host and port according to the rules, updating the URL if a match is found.

methods.name: AddRuleFromString
methods.description: Parses a rule string to add either a mapping or exclusion rule.

methods.name: SetRulesFromString
methods.description: Sets multiple rules from a comma-separated string, clearing existing rules.
